work.author: Thomas Aquinas
work.description: Aquinas's sixteen disputed questions on evil. Question 16, in twelve articles, treats the devils: whether they have bodies, whether they were created evil, the object and the instant of the first sin, the obstinacy of their will, and their knowledge and power. A locus is question.article, optionally with its division.
work.title: Quaestiones disputatae de malo
